exactness_and_policy.derivative: Q'=H/W^2+d*(R90(H')/S-R90(H)*(H dot H')/S^3), S=sqrt(H dot H)
exactness_and_policy.cusp_equation: d*W^2*(H' cross H)+S^3=0; roots of the squared polynomial are isolated exactly and opposite-sign roots are rejected
exactness_and_policy.projective_boundary: all roots of W on the closed unit interval are rejected before evaluation, singularity analysis, or exact materialization
exactness_and_policy.ph_materialization: when H dot H=S^2, the exact homogeneous parallel is (XS-dW*Hy,YS+dW*Hx,WS)
exactness_and_policy.bernstein_completion: strict positivity of WS is first certified on [0,1], then exact incremental degree elevation continues until every weight coefficient is positive; the former arbitrary +32 cap is deleted
exactness_and_policy.strict: STRICT requires exact sign, root, square, regularity, and branch evidence and never substitutes a finite approximation
exactness_and_policy.approximate_512: APPROXIMATE_512 uses the same exact carrier and may terminate only an unresolved equality/sign predicate at the inherited 512-bit terminal
exactness_and_policy.endpoint_identity: structural t=0 and t=1 rational evaluations return the retained exact endpoints directly
exactness_and_policy.common_circle_center: independently authored algebraic circular conics recover the minimal tangent-normal center and validate it against the implicit conic
